links.effect: Initial recalibration of an existing single-center model demonstrated poor discrimination (AUROC 0.60 – 0.78).

links.outcome: Discrimination after recalibrating and extending model with new features using local multicenter data
links.effect: After adding features, AUROC rose to 0.79 - 0.80 and AUPRC 0.13 – 0.21 in both datasets, versus AUROC 0.60 – 0.78 for the recalibrated original.
links.quote: Following the addition of new features, we report higher AUROC values of 0.79 - 0.80 and AUPRC values of 0.13 – 0.21 in both datasets.
